The joggers are fitted for casual wear but lean aggressively towards a very thin waist. With Round face shape, this exaggerated flare can feel disproportionate to his frame; it may create an unnatural hourglass effect that emphasizes the body's curves rather than balancing them in harmony with his 'Summer Cool' aesthetic.

The title suggests a professional or semi-formal context, but the TPO is explicitly stated as Daily / Casual Outing. The navy shirt worn open over tee combined with linen joggers offers significantly less structured formality than an off-shoulder jacket and tailored trousers for a daily look.

risks.description: The combination creates a visually fragmented look. The sharp, structured navy blue of the shirt contrasts aggressively with the soft, grey oversize tee and clean white sneakers. For this individual's 'Summer Cool' face shape (round) and color preference, this clash risks looking overly aggressive or clinical rather than casual, potentially undermining the relaxed aesthetic.

The mid-thigh jogger with a cropped sneaker combination feels restrictive. While it offers minimal height to counterbalance potential weight variance, the tight cut of the jeans against the relaxed top creates visual compression that can inadvertently highlight facial features or narrow shoulders, contrary to summer flowy movement.

The TPO (Treat/Place/Organization) is 'Casual Outing', which requires low-stakes style. The jacketed button-down adds unnecessary layering and rigidity that contradicts the relaxed, effortless vibe of a day out with friends or weekend activities.

improvement_points: Consider replacing the structured navy blue top for an alternative such as white linen shirts worn over grey tees to better blend with skin tones and maintain casual elegance without blocking movement.

If maintaining a more grounded look is desired, consider adding a light patterned scarf or adjusting the jogger cut from mid-thigh down to knee-length if it feels too constricting against summer skin.
